purpose: Freeze the Conductellence 1.0 core system boundary so WP03-WP07 close existing obligations without architectural feature expansion.

frozen_constitutional_topology.rule: Counts are frozen for CDX 1.0 closure. A change requires an approved boundary exception before merge.

closure_obligations.obligation: Constitutional closure/adoption process using the existing CDX-LAW-001 topology
Independent SPETL evidence custody, attestation and verification
Final acceptance, release packaging and CDX 1.0 release decision

allowed_during_freeze: correct defects or contradictions inside existing domains
harden existing controls, audits, schemas, contracts and evidence paths
implement independent evidence custody required by existing blockers
enable or evidence repository protection required by existing blockers
refine distribution and runtime contracts without creating a new authority class
perform existing state transitions when their already-defined gates are satisfied
prepare release artifacts, compatibility declarations and migration instructions
prohibited_without_boundary_exception: add a new first-class top-level CDX subsystem/domain
add or remove a Foundational Principle
add or remove a CDX-LAW-001 section
replace any canonical identity listed in canonical_identities
create non-human sovereignty or authority above human sovereign authority
turn CDX into a universal super-admin with unrestricted downstream write authority
collapse repository binding, runtime verification, release and enforcement into one state
remove an open blocker by redefining the requirement instead of satisfying it
bring product-specific downstream business logic into the CDX core

explicitly_not_core_1_0_execution.work: Canonical anchor migration across applicable repositories

boundary_exception_process.rule: An exception must be explicit and reviewed before the frozen element changes. Silence, implementation convenience or downstream pressure is not approval.

release_rule: CDX 1.0 closure is completion of the frozen core, not expansion of the core.
